Use case: illustration-story

STYLE: Match the approved black-and-lime ink editorial example shown in the conversation: deep charcoal #151A18, acid lime #CCF43B, warm off-white lettering, rough hand-drawn pen hatching and energetic dry brush strokes. Clean hierarchy and very few elements. Obvious illustration, absolutely not photography or photorealism. Do not copy the sample's athlete, old date, score, or any of its words.

COMPOSITION: Bold text occupies the left 52%. Two recognizable REAL basketball players in an imagined dynamic one-on-one basketball matchup occupy the right 48%, both faces clearly visible in three-quarter view. Frame from the head to mid-thigh with deliberate lower-body crop, keep both heads and all hands fully inside the image. Davante Gardner protects a single orange basketball near his torso with both hands, pivots into a drive; Levi Randolph has a low defensive stance, one open hand raised and the other extended laterally. Distinct and anatomically clear arms and hands with natural five-finger anatomy; no interlocking fingers or merged limbs. No basket or scoreboard needed. Brushwork suggests movement.

REAL PERSON IDENTITY REFERENCES: Official profile portraits were visually checked in this conversation.
1.
